Evaluators rate translations on Completeness, Semantic Correctness, and Overall quality.

We used Best-Worst Scaling, which has been shown to produce more reliable results than ranking scales. Specifically, each score is computed as the percentage of times it was selected as best minus the percentage of times it was selected as worst, and ranges from -1 (unanimously worst) to +1 (unanimously best).
